title: Canonical ordered integration and adjoint-transpose constructions
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring and let $X,Y,Z$ be schemes. In the ordinary small-etale derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], use the exact inverse image $D_f$, compact support $F_f$ [def-amb-etale-compact-support], canonical coefficient-first projection $P_f$ [def-pur-compact-support-projection-map], derived tensor [def-kun-derived-tensor], its unit and associator [lem-kun-tensor-unit], and exact pullback comparisons [def-pur-etale-exact-pullback-unit-composition-comparisons]. Define $\operatorname{object}_f(W,K)=D_fK\otimes W$. Given $t:F_fW\to\mathbf1$ and invertible $P_f(W,K)$, integration is $P_f(W,K)^{-1}$ followed by $1_K\otimes t$ and the right unitor. For an actual adjunction $F_f\dashv R_f$ [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-mate], gamma is its Hom transpose. The unit identification $D_f\mathbf1\otimes W\simeq W$ uses the exact-to-derived comparison, pullback unit comparison and left unitor; orientation is its inverse followed by gamma at the unit. Theta at $L$ is the transpose of inverse projection with $R_f\mathbf1$, tensor of the counit and the right unitor. The tensor comparison for $D_f$ is transported through its isomorphism with $Lf^*$ [lem-kun-inverse-image-monoidal]. Reassociation first applies the exact compositor, the inverse tensor associator, and the inverse transported tensor comparison. For finite $A$ and compactifiable quasi-compact maps, rightMate is the adjunction-preserving isomorphism $R_h\simeq R_fR_g$ induced by the fixed compact-support compositor [def-sf-etale-support-compositor, def-weil-pbc-composite-adjunction]. These nine canonical constructions fix the tensor order, unit identification and adjunction-mate normalization. The auxiliary integrationUnitObjectIso and integrationProjection package the same unit and coefficient-first projection constructions over a general coefficient category before specialization.
